title: Guide walk-through names every dashboard-owned policy input per policy-shape and every shipped elicit
asA: operator issuing an Access policy from the dashboard side
iWant: the guide to name every input the dashboard needs per policy shape (email domain for email-domain; group name and identity provider for group-membership; service-token id and secret elicits for service-token-only and service-token-plus-email-domain; application/path scope for every shape) and every shipped elicit
soThat: a policy issued from the guide walk-through is complete without back-and-forth between the guide and the vendor docs

acceptanceCriteria.description: The shipped guide (guide/<slug>.md within this blueprint) contains a section Policy shape enum that names, per policy-shape option, the required dashboard-owned inputs: email-domain names the required email-domain input; group-membership names the required group-name input and the required identity-provider selection; service-token-only names the required service-token id and paired secret (linked to the bypass-service-auth-id elicit); service-token-plus-email-domain names both the email-domain and the service-token pair; every shape names the required application-vs-path scope input. The guide additionally names every shipped elicit (application-host, selfhosted-app-id, audience, jwks-url, policy-shape, bypass-service-auth-id) with its runtime effect.
acceptanceCriteria.when: a source-tree grep asserts the required substrings per shape and elicit
acceptanceCriteria.then: every required substring is present; a fixture that omits any of them refuses the probe with a stable code guide.policy-inputs-missing naming which substring is absent

description: Story owns the guide-section presence assertion for the policy-shape enum. Per section 7a, this story carries a single AC because the guide names no runtime failure path for the guide-section-presence mechanism.
